revisions.arc: arc-b7-v2 (books/book-07-void-roads/CHAPTER_ARCHITECTURE.md, editor PASS r4, Chapter 15 card)

pov.mode: close third, past tense — the series' established voice: the cataloguing narrator (counts things, names places precisely), diegetic documents in italics with their own plain first-person register (the Power Log), emotion through procedure and objects, dry oblique dialogue, PG-13, no modern idiom.
knowledge_boundary: Cael is nineteen; ten fragments + the located anomaly. Party SIX at Thornwater, a week of tables. Lira one-armed (slung, load-restricted); Karis's voice nearly back.

Karis's field report is the chapter's structure — five findings in her formal register. She COINS 'the Quieting' here (a process, not a place) and the book adopts it from this chapter on; before this line nobody has said the word.

Finding two (Book 9 plant, observed only): every Arbiter in the party went silent at the same line, same stride, same instant, same way — Wind, Iron Skin, Ember, Shadow, Tide, Iron R1 to Bronze — and Karis enters the sentence she does not know how to file: a personal spiritual entity should not fail like a piece of equipment on a circuit. NO explanation.

Finding three (Book 8 plant, as a LIMIT): she dates the fused stone against every masonry stratum in her three boxes (registry-era, standardization-era, pre-standardization, founding-era waystation stone from Prynn's archive) and reaches her method's limit: older than the registry; older than the standardization directive; older than the two-hundred-year modification and the sub-layer beneath it (Book 6's findings, which the circle knows); older, she says, using the word ONCE, than [UNBOUND] — 'older than the word they retired, and I can't say by how much. Entered as a limit, not a finding. We explained the middle of the story in Ostrand. This is before the beginning, and I don't have a ruler for it.' The word [UNBOUND] appears exactly once in the chapter and nowhere else in the book.

Finding four: the stakes, Seln's map blanks, the contract's registry prose — the Compact knows, measured, filed, drew maps with holes. Entered once; not pursued. Finding five: Cael's ten fragments work inside — she has the data; she writes the observation and STOPS at the interpretation: 'I have a hypothesis and I'm not entering it, because entering it would make it a finding, and it isn't one. It's a fear.'

Karis's closing dialogue (fixed): 'The circle's perfect. Perfect isn't natural. Somebody made a floor that turns Paths off. It's older than anything I can date. And it doesn't turn you off. Three facts. I'm not putting a verb between them.' Cael: 'You said you weren't entering the hypothesis.' Karis: 'I'm not. I'm saying it to you. That's different.' NOTHING beyond the three facts; no maker, no purpose, no 'Architect'.
Cael has still told nobody why he thinks it worked (Lira first, Chapter 16).

purpose: Karis's chapter: the researcher aimed at the largest primary source of her life, the Quieting given its name, and the book's [UNBOUND] discipline honored as a stratum limit — five findings entered in her formal register across a week at Thornwater, the fifth one stopped at its interpretation because she is honest about the difference between a finding and a fear.

scene_shape.opening_state: Thornwater, a week of tables: the copied carvings, the paced perimeter, the stake's number, the three boxes open.
scene_shape.pov_goal: Watch Karis do what she is for, and hold his own silence one more chapter.
scene_shape.opposition: Her method's limits (no ruler for the floor's age); her fear (the fifth finding); his unfiled fact.
scene_shape.turn: The five findings in order: the name; the failure mode (identical Arbiter failure — equipment on a circuit); the strata limit with [UNBOUND] once; the stakes; the thing she will not write.
scene_shape.choice: Karis stops her pen at the interpretation and says the three facts aloud to Cael instead, refusing a verb between them.
scene_shape.outcome: The Quieting named; the floor dated as 'older than everything'; the Compact's knowledge entered once; the hypothesis unentered; Cael's log (mid-scene): 'Karis dated the floor. Older than everything. She has a hypothesis she won't write down. I have four people who saw what I did inside, and one healer who felt what I'm made of, and I've told none of them why I think it worked. Lira first. Tomorrow. It's always been Lira first.'
scene_shape.closing_state: The chapter ENDS ON DIALOGUE (the previous chapter ended on the log): Cael: 'You said you weren't entering the hypothesis.' Karis: 'I'm not. I'm saying it to you. That's different.'

must_include: Karis's five findings in her formal register, in order, each landing on a thread the reader carries: (1) the name 'the Quieting' coined with her reason (process, not place); (2) the identical Arbiter failure and her unfileable sentence; (3) the strata limit with the masonry strata named, [UNBOUND] used exactly once, and her 'middle of the story / before the beginning / no ruler' lines; (4) the stakes/map-blanks/registry-prose entered once; (5) the observation about Cael's fragments written, the interpretation stopped, with her 'It's a fear.' line verbatim.
The copied carvings as objects (lines in no alphabet she owns), the paced perimeter's arithmetic recalled, the stake's number.
Cael's log entry mid-scene (as given), before the closing exchange.
Karis's three-facts speech verbatim and the closing exchange verbatim; the chapter ENDS on 'That's different.'
Oryn present at Thornwater (working her route's backlog if she appears; at most a beat); Lira one-armed; Seln and Brom in register.
Manuscript format: H1 '# Chapter 15 — Strata', prose only, '---' breaks, ends on the last line of prose.
plants: 'The Quieting' as the book's term from here on.
The floor older than every stratum including the retired word (Book 8).
Karis's unentered hypothesis (never entered in this book).
payoffs: Ch10's measurements and carvings; Ch12's stakes and blanks; B3/B6's strata discipline recognized by the circle.
prohibited_outcomes: No maker, purpose, intelligence, 'Architect', 'primordial', 'before the system' in anyone's mouth or narration; Karis states three facts and refuses a verb; [UNBOUND] appears once only.
No disclosure by Cael (Ch16); no fight; no fragment use; no travel.
The chapter does not end on a log entry or an image.
No modern idiom; no feeling/growth declarations; tic caps; no metadata.
Do not use the phrase 'at the pitch' (or 'at that pitch') — it is at the book's cap already (10 uses in Chapters 1–4). Vary attribution registers with other means.

allowed: The week of tables as texture (paper, cord, chalk, the boxes as shelves, Thornwater's autumn); Karis's method-register in full; the others' small beats; Oryn's route backlog as a glimpse.
Dialogue in established voices; Cael's interior cataloguing of Karis working.
approval_required: Any new named entity; any stratum or dating fact beyond those listed; any additional [UNBOUND] use.
forbidden: Theory/ontology; disclosure; fights; travel; a log or image ending; metadata.
